requirement.summary: KDS2.0 Printing - KDS trigger POS mark delivery API to print runner chit - Dev
requirement.description:
Enhancement:

1. KDS send request to POS through API: to trigger Mark Delivery function key when status changed from "Completed" to "Delivered" in:

- Expo Screen

- Station Screen

KDS will trigger POSiApi to notify POS what exact item(s) mark "delivered" in KDS.

Error Handling:

- Table Locked or Vacant: Wait until the table unlock/the table status change to not vacant

- Cannot find the item under Check: follow the check number, mark delivery for the remaining item

- Item has been marked as delivered: mark delivery for the remaining item

2. Include the following:

i) Add interface setting in KDS module (Infrasys Cloud)

ii) Sync the interface setting from Infrasys Cloud to KDS 2.0

iii) KDS 2.0 client will notify POS the item once it is delivered by POSiAPI (mark delivery api)

3. Add a new section in System Config KDS module for Interface setup:

- Endpoint

- Path

- Secret Key

- Consumer Key

- Consumer Secret

4. KDS need to pass the shiji_KDS as interface code to trigger the Mark/Unmark Delivery API and replace the empid, emppw by api user number. (no need setup)

- The code should be included in the request parameter to POS mark delivery API.

- Under this setup, the employee id and emlpoyee password will follow the application user number.

- The code can be a vchar 128 limit. (support both upper / lower / mix case)

requirement.summary: Push Notification - Extra leading zero is not removed from the "From Table Number" field during table change
requirement.description:
Background

In the table.change event, the table number format of the "from_table_no" and "to_table_no" fields should be consistent. During a Table Change operation, the "from_table_no" field does not remove leading zero, while the to_table_no field does.

Workflow

1. Open an old check with table number starting with a letter (e.g. V11)

2. Click function "Change Table"

3. Enter a target table number starting with a letter (e.g. V10)

4. Click button "OK"

Actual result

In the table.change event, the "from_table_no" is set to "0V11" but the "to_table_no" is set to "V10"

Expected result

In the table.change event, the "from_table_no" should set to "V11" and the "to_table_no" is set to "V10"
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-70044] Push Notification - Extra Leading Zero is Not Removed from the "From Table Number" Field During Table Change (Andy)
Descriptions:
In the table change event of Push Notification, the field “from table number” keeps a leading 0 when the table number starts with a letter, while the field “to table number” removes it, so the two fields use different formats
Workflow
1. Open an old check with a table number starting with a non-numeric character (e.g. V11)
2. Click function “Change Table”
3. Enter a table number starting with a non-numeric character (e.g. V10)
4. Click button “OK”
5. In the table change event of Push Notification, the field “from table number” keeps a leading 0 (e.g. 0V11) and the field “to table number” does not (e.g. V10)
Expected result:
The fields “from table number” and “to table number” use the same format, and no extra 0 is appended before the table number
It is fixed in current version
Setup:
None

requirement.summary: HKJC - TMS - Special Amenities additional charge stays 0.00 after selection on Edit Reservation
requirement.description:
Email/ ZOHO Title:

HKJC - TMS - Special Amenities additional charge stays 0.00 after selection on Edit Reservation

Use Case:

HKJC user edits a reservation and selects a special amenity that costs $10. The selected-item tag shows the price, but the Special Amenities additional charge box stays 0.00. The same happens for other self-selected services. Car park, coach go, coach return, and table fee still show their charges.

Steps to Reproduce:

Edit Reservation>Add Special Amenities>Select a chargeable amenity>Confirm

Current Result:

The amenity tag shows the price and quantity, for example Table Setting-Add Seat @$10.00 x1 $10, but the Special Amenities additional charge and its total stay 0.00. Saving stores that 0.00 category total. The service line price is still stored. [Unexpected]

Expected Result:

After confirming the amenity, the Special Amenities additional charge shows the selected amount (unit price times quantity), and that amount is saved as the category total. [Expected]

Root Cause [Optional]:

Related to HERO-66094, HERO-66260, and HERO-66506.

On Edit Reservation, confirming a self-selected service no longer recalculates the category charge. The selected-item tag is still updated from the service price, so it shows $10, but the charge box keeps the amount loaded with the reservation. When that category had no charge, the box stays 0.00 and save writes 0.00 as the category total.

Car park, coach go, and coach return still recalculate after confirm. Table fee still recalculates when the table changes.

Fix: after confirming a self-selected service, run the same category charge recalculation that car park and table fee already run, and write the new category total back so the charge box and the saved total both show the selected amount.

requirement.summary: [Pentest - 2026] Unauthenticated export of the full loyalty - Member Module
requirement.description:
+Refer to:

Penetration Testing Report 2026-11-02 - Infrasys POS HQ.docx

Finding:+

An application is vulnerable to missing authentication for a critical function when a server-side action that returns or acts on sensitive data can be invoked without a valid authenticated session. A common cause is that a module's HTML "entry" views are protected by an authentication layer while the data and export endpoints the views consume are not, so an attacker who addresses those endpoints directly bypasses the login screen entirely. Where the exposed action is a bulk export of personal data, a single unauthenticated request discloses the whole data set at once; where the request also carries an attacker-controlled field selector, the attacker additionally chooses which fields to extract. The exposure is most serious when the data is regulated personal data and when the only control in front of the endpoint is a weak shared secret rather than per-user authentication.

Proof:

Step 1 - Control - the client holds no session (the HTML listing is protected, an unrelated endpoint answers the same cookie-less client)

|

- HTML listing, no cookie -> redirected to the gate (surface is protected):

GET /accounts/shijipentest/eng/member/profile_management/listing   ->  HTTP 302 (gate/login)

- In the SAME run, from the SAME cookie-less client, an unrelated unauthenticated

- endpoint on the same host answered 200 with data, proving the client carried no session.

Step 2 - Unauthenticated export returns the database

Request:

| GET /accounts/shijipentest/eng/member/profile_management/exportMember/fileType:csv/headerList:Account No.,Salutation,Last Name,First Name,Alt. Name,Contact (Mobile),Contact (Office),Contact (Home),Email (Personal),Organization,Expiry Date,Profile Status/listing/page:1/sort:memb_last_name_l1/direction:asc/tab/exportPage:1 HTTP/2

Host: pentest-hq.hero-cloud.com

User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

[ no Cookie header of any kind ]

Response:

| HTTP/2 200 OK

Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8

Content-Disposition: attachment;filename=member_20261029_225601.zip

Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary

PK.... (ZIP archive containing member.csv)

[ A request with no session returned a ZIP export of the member database. ]

Step 3 - The archive contains the full member records

| member.csv - header row + 9 data rows, one per member:

"No.","Account No.","Salutation","Last Name","First Name","Alt. Name","Contact (Mobile)","Contact (Office)","Contact (Home)","Email (Personal)","Organization","Expiry Date","Profile Status"

"1","543309","mr","Probe084a4d4e","Member084a4d4e","Probe Member 084a4d4e","53122003122","33122223122","23122113122","prb084a4d4e@example.invalid","Probe Org prb084a4d4e","","Active"

"2","2978130","mr","Probe2d715285","Member2d715285","Probe Member 2d715285","53633003633","33633223633","23633113633","prb2d715285@example.invalid","Probe Org prb2d715285","","Active"

"3","4198454","mr","Probe40103624","Member40103624","Probe Member 40103624","58400008400","38400228400","28400118400","prb40103624@example.invalid","Probe Org prb40103624","","Active"

[ 9 rows of full personal data returned to an unauthenticated client. Records are synthetic profiles seeded by the tester. The headerList path segment is attacker-chosen and selects the exported columns. ]

Recommendation:

Require a valid authenticated session on the member export action itself, not only on the HTML listing page. The same server-side guard that redirects the unauthenticated listing to the gate/login must run for the export action and for every data and action endpoint under the Profile Management controller. Treat the shared tenant Access Password as a weak gate that must never be the only control in front of personal data. Verify by requesting the export with no cookie after the fix and confirming it is redirected exactly as the HTML listing is.

References:

CWE-306: Missing Authentication for a Critical Function

CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

OWASP Top 10 2021 - A01: Broken Access Control

GDPR Article 32 - Security of processing; Articles 33-34 - breach notification

requirement.summary: [SSDLC] Dependency checking fix - upgrade TMS react moment to 2.31+
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing :  HERO-69850  [[SSDLC] Dependency checking fix - upgrade TMS react moment to 2.31+]
Descriptions :
The TMS Operation screen used an older date library (moment.js 2.30.1) that was flagged by the SSDLC dependency check.
The library is upgraded to 2.31.0. Operators do not change how they use the screen. QC should confirm that date and time still display correctly and that the page does not show a script error after login.
Steps to Reproduce Issue :
1. Log in to TMS Operation and open Current View.
2. Check the footer clock at the bottom of the screen. It should show today's date, weekday and time, for example 2026-10-22 (Thursday) 11:47 AM. The clock should update every second.
3. On Current View, check the booking date next to the outlet and meal period. It should show a valid date such as 2026-10-22 (Thu).
4. Click Walk In. Confirm the Walk In panel opens. Date and time on the main screen should still look correct. Click Cancel without saving.
5. Switch language (English, Traditional Chinese Hong Kong, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean). The footer weekday name should follow the selected language. Date numbers should stay correct.
6. If the site uses Polish, Swedish, Portuguese (Brazil) or German, switch to that language as well and re-check the footer weekday. These languages had small wording updates in this library version.
7. Pass if dates and times still display, the clock ticks, and no error appears on screen. Fail if the footer is blank, the date looks wrong, or the page shows a script error.
Setup :  N/A
No configuration change is required. Deploy the updated TMS Operation frontend.
